top_signals.title: Asia-US West Coast container spot rates fall below $8,000 as US avoids LA-Long Beach port strike
top_signals.summary:
Trans-Pacific spot rates are slipping from peak-season highs after a tentative LA-Long Beach port labor deal. Trade-policy uncertainty and carrier capacity cuts could still keep prices elevated.

top_signals.title: Ocean rates still double last year as congestion idles 3.6 million TEUs
top_signals.summary:
DHL: Ocean rates are up 138% on 2025, and 3.6 million TEUs are stuck in congestion. It expects the disruption to keep shippers focused on resilience over price ahead of the 2027 RFQ season.
